message.content:
Here’s a quick‑look at the **long weekends** in Canada for 2023, based on the federal holidays that either fall on a Friday/Monday or are observed on a Monday when they land on a weekend. (Some provinces have extra holidays that can also create long weekends, but the list below covers the nationwide federal holidays.)

| Holiday | Date (2023) | Day of Week | Long‑Weekend Span |
|---------|-------------|-------------|-------------------|
| New Year’s Day | Jan 1 | Sunday | **Jan 1 – Jan 2** (Sunday + Monday) |
| Family Day (BC, AB, SK, NB, ON, PE) | Feb 20 | Monday | **Feb 18 – Feb 20** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Good Friday | Apr 7 | Friday | **Apr 7 – Apr 9** (Friday + Saturday + Sunday) |
| Victoria Day | May 22 | Monday | **May 20 – May 22** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Canada Day | Jul 1 | Saturday | **Jul 1 – Jul 3** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Labour Day | Sep 4 | Monday | **Sep 2 – Sep 4** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Thanksgiving | Oct 9 | Monday | **Oct 7 – Oct 9** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Remembrance Day | Nov 11 | Saturday | **Nov 11 – Nov 13** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |
| Christmas Day | Dec 25 | Monday | **Dec 23 – Dec 25** (Saturday + Sunday + Monday) |

### Quick notes

- **Observed dates**: When a holiday falls on a weekend, Canada typically observes it on the following Monday. That’s why Canada Day (Sat Jul 1) and Remembrance Day (Sat Nov 11) are “observed” on Monday, creating a three‑day stretch.
- **Provincial variations**: Some provinces (e.g., Ontario, British Columbia, Alberta, Saskatchewan, New Brunswick, Prince Edward Island) observe Family Day on the third Monday in February. Others have their own holidays (e.g., St. Patrick’s Day in Ontario, St. John’s Day in Newfoundland & Labrador) that can also create long weekends.
- **Boxing Day**: Dec 26, 2023 falls on a Tuesday, so it doesn’t create a long weekend.

Feel free to plug these dates into your holiday‑planning app! If you need province‑specific long weekends or any other details, just let me know.
